name: sagebrush_figures
summary: How figures are shown: "auto" (an SVG, or a sharp PNG when the SVG would be over 1 MB), "svg", "png" or "both".
doc: "auto" (the default): a figure is shown as its SVG, sharp at any zoom, unless that SVG would be over 1 MB; then as a PNG drawn at twice its size and shown at its size (sharp on a high-density screen), with a line under it saying so. "svg" and "png" always show that format, "both" shows both, and "reset" goes back to the default (the Jupyter kernel's `--figures`, or `SAGEBRUSH_FIGURES`, else "auto"). Without an argument, the current setting. It is the same setting in every language: `sagebrush.figures` in Python and Sage.
